requirements.requirement: The system must define a confidence object schema containing fields: completeness, recency, agreement, and overall_confidence.
The system must enforce that each confidence field (completeness, recency, agreement, overall_confidence) is represented as a normalized numeric value between 0 and 1.
The system must define the confidence object as a serializable structure compatible with existing evaluation API response formats.
The system must attach the confidence object as a nested field within provider quality score responses.
The system must attach the confidence object as a nested field within clinical trial quality score responses.
The system must ensure that the addition of the confidence object does not remove or rename any existing fields in the evaluation response.
The system must define the confidence schema in a centralized location accessible by evaluation services.
The system must include field-level documentation or descriptors for completeness, recency, agreement, and overall_confidence within the schema definition.
The system must validate that all required confidence fields are present before attaching the object to a response.
The system must reject or flag any confidence object where one or more fields fall outside the 0 to 1 range.
The system must support optional inclusion of a metadata subfield indicating the timestamp of confidence calculation.
The system must handle missing component values (completeness, recency, or agreement) by allowing nulls while still requiring overall_confidence to be present.
The system must ensure that if the confidence object cannot be constructed, the evaluation response still returns successfully without the confidence field.
The system must maintain backward compatibility such that clients not expecting the confidence field can parse the response without error.
